name: Century Entertainment International Holdings Limited
summary: Century Entertainment International Holdings Limited, incorporated in 1997 and based in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong, is an investment holding firm in gaming and entertainment in China and Hong Kong. Its two divisions are gaming and entertainment, which manages VIP rooms and gaming tables, and AR/VR and mobile game solutions, which develops mobile games and augmented and virtual reality applications. It was formerly Amax International Holdings Limited until December 2019.
